_doc: NFRI harness design system — dual reference: ai-transformation.fyi (analytical index UI) + theoceancompany.com (cinematic manifesto hero). Both palettes preserved; consumed by harness/design_system.py.

cinematic_hero.title: Britain is reconnecting industry to a network that can no longer promise to keep the lights on.
cinematic_hero.lede: Data centres, batteries, and factories are clearing the queue on non-firm connections — and the insurance market is carrying the gap blind. NFRI scores who is exposed, who is prepared, and where the margin of safety has gone negative.

welcome_modal.title: Welcome to the Non-Firm Power Risk Index
welcome_modal.subtitle: An outside-in view on interruptible grid power across the UK insurance market
welcome_modal.body: We score participants on two dimensions — Exposure and Preparedness — to derive a Margin of Safety. The electro-industrial stack runs on electrons; this index runs on the registers that say whether those electrons are firm.
welcome_modal.footnote: All scores trace to registers, filings, or cited research. Assessed values are marked; anything below the publication gate is PROVISIONAL.
welcome_modal.tip: Click any card or scatter point for the full sub-factor decomposition. Use search and filters to narrow the universe.
